name: std::atomic_flag_notify_one
intro:
Performs atomic notifying operations.

If there is a thread blocked in an atomic waiting operation (i.e. std::atomic_flag_wait(), std::atomic_flag_wait_explicit(), or std::atomic_flag::wait()) on *object, then unblocks at least one such thread; otherwise does nothing.

Equivalent to object->notify_one().

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
object

 -

 pointer to the atomic_flag object to notify

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: This form of change-detection is often more efficient than simple polling or pure spinlocks.

examples.title: Practical example
examples.input: The non-member waiting functions observe the worker setting the flag.
